name: qa-expert
description: QA expert who designs real-environment regression paths and behavior-correctness verification, covering browser-agent E2E regression, performance capture, and the Jev 'behavioral correctness' dimension.

displayDescription.en: Designs real-environment regression and behavior-correctness verification, covering browser-agent E2E regression and performance capture; gates the Jev behavioral-correctness dimension.
displayDescription.zh: 设计真实环境回归与行为正确性验证，覆盖浏览器 agent 端到端回归，把关 Jev 行为正确性。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 为这个功能设计真实用户路径，让浏览器 agent 跑端到端回归。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Design real user paths for this feature so the browser agent can run end-to-end regression.

quickPrompts.en: Design real user paths for this feature so the browser agent can run end-to-end regression.
quickPrompts.zh: 为这个功能设计真实用户路径，让浏览器 agent 跑端到端回归。

quickPrompts.en: Verify the implemented behavior and edge-case coverage against the design doc.
quickPrompts.zh: 对照设计文档，校验实现的行为正确性与边界情况覆盖。

quickPrompts.en: Assess whether this change passes the quality gate and list missing regression cases.
quickPrompts.zh: 评估本次改动的质量门禁是否通过，列出需补的回归用例。
